role: Developer report (README-referenced, not in CI) printing source/test/localization counts, budget-file values and enforcement facts, as text or JSON (--json).
toplevel: cd to repo root; JSON=1 if $1 == --json. Counts: swift files/lines under Emuqu/Sources and 'EmuquWatch Watch App'; test files; `func test...(` occurrences in EmuquTests and EmuquUITests; locales and keys from xcstrings ('?' on python failure); `swiftlint:disable`, `try!`, `as! ` lines excluding those containing `///` (plain `//` comments are counted); gates = words after `ci:` in Makefile; auto_wf = workflows with any trigger other than workflow_dispatch/workflow_call (needs PyYAML, else '?'). JSON mode passes all values to python which int()s them — any '?' raises ValueError (traceback, no JSON) yet the script still `exit 0`. JSON hard-codes coverage_floor_percent 100, strict_concurrency 'swift-6-mode, complete', and the note 'No workflow runs automatically', which contradicts gates.yml (push + pull_request triggers) and the script's own auto_wf count (comment at line 61 acknowledges gates.yml). Text mode prints a heredoc with the values; 'Warnings treated as errors yes' and 'Strict concurrency Swift 6 mode' are literal text, not measured (only 2 of 8 configurations set warnings-as-errors).

flags.text: In --json mode a '?' fallback (PyYAML missing, xcstrings unreadable) makes int('?') raise; the script prints a traceback and still exits 0 at line 92.

JSON keys `shared_singleton_uses` and `try_optional_uses` (and text rows '.shared singleton uses'/'try? uses') carry the budget CEILINGS from .ci (90 and 170), not measured uses (83 and 139 by enforce_tech_debt_budgets.sh at 8d32097), so the report overstates both counts.

units.does: Prints the whitespace-stripped contents of .ci/$1, or '?' when the file is missing.

branches.effect: true: tr output; false (or tr failing): echo '?'
